content: React + Capacitor iOS golf scoring app. Full context in CLAUDE.md (auto-loaded each session).

- Package manager: Bun (always use `bun`, not npm/yarn)
- Supabase project: puqgbsxabcyxrbwwoznn
- Bundle ID: dev.matchgolf.app
- iOS: open App.xcworkspace (not .xcodeproj)
- RevenueCat key already in Xcode build settings — don't touch

- Node 25.6.1, Bun 1.3.9, CocoaPods 1.16.2 installed via Homebrew
- `bun install` and `pod install` completed
- .env configured with Supabase credentials
- Xcode not yet installed (user needs to download from App Store)

- React Native / Expo SDK 54 managed workflow, TypeScript strict
- Supabase (auth, postgres, storage, edge functions)
- expo-av for Audio playback/recording
- expo-audio (useAudioRecorder) for recording
- @expo/vector-icons Ionicons — installed, used throughout
- EAS Build configured (eas.json present)

- Colors: bg `#1C1410`, card `#251A14`, coral `#FF6B4A`, cream `#FAF0E6`, muted `#B09080`/`#7A5A4A`
- Font: Georgia everywhere
- All icons are Ionicons — NO emoji characters in the UI
- Recording duration: fixed 30s (`DURATION = 30` constant in RecordScreen), no selector

- `src/components/ScreenHeader.tsx` — shared header with back/close icons; `rightAction` accepts `{ label?, icon?, onPress }`
- `src/components/ThoughtCard.tsx` — feed card with tap-to-seek progress bar
- `src/components/BottomNav.tsx` — tab bar with Ionicons
- `src/screens/ListeningScreen.tsx` — full-screen player with PanResponder scrubber
- `src/screens/RecordScreen.tsx` — recording screen, fixed 30s
- `src/screens/FriendsScreen.tsx` + `FindFriendsScreen.tsx` — friend discovery
- `src/lib/sav

- `durationMsRef` kept in sync with `durationMs` state so PanResponder closures always see current duration
- `scrubStartProgressRef` stores progress at drag start; `dx / SCRUBBER_WIDTH` applied as delta
- `SCRUBBER_WIDTH = SCREEN_WIDTH - 48` module-level constant (safe in PanResponder closures)
- Pause on grant, seek+resume on release

- `eas build --platform ios --profile preview` for TestFlight builds
- App slug: outloud, bundle id in app.json
File unknown was edited 29 times this session — likely a hot path worth monitoring.
